title: b7z9.30.5: C: create rf_health ztest suite consuming ccp16 vectors
description: C rf_health.c has no test suite. Create lichen/tests/rf_health/ ztest consuming ccp16_utilization.json and ccp16_ema_loss_threshold.json vectors. Test AdaptiveSFSelect steps, SF floors, and loss threshold. Depends on .30.1/.30.2/.30.3 landing the C implementation.
close_reason: Host CTest lichen/tests/rf_health_vectors consumes the nine SF-pinning slot_selection cases in test/vectors/ccp16.json against lichen_rf_health_adaptive_sf (threshold table: critical/high density, SNR poor/good, load high, default 10, low-density upgrade) — first vector-file coverage for the C adaptive-SF table (previously only unit boundaries in tests/rf_health and routing_dispatch). Inputs mapped per spec: snr_db -> snr.avg_fp, load_factor -> load_factor_fp, density via record_density; expected sf compared exactly. Missing/malformed cases fail closed. Gates: ctest green under ASan/UBSan (caught a UB negative-shift in the harness, fixed), gcc -Werror clean, cppcheck clean. Reviews via kimi-k3: pass1 correctness found 2 of 9 cases missing (the only ones exercising the density>8 -> SF11 branch) — added, plus stale CMake workaround block removed; pass2 security PASS (conversions inert, UBSan-guarded, committed-oracle trust boundary documented); pass3 edge timed out 3x -> self-review fallback per loop protocol (fail-closed field handling, needle collision-safety, duplicate-name behavior verified). Note for parent b7z9.30: gradient.c sf_select (hysteresis path) remains covered by routing_dispatch boundary tests; ccp16.json vectors pin the rf_health table path.
